messages:
Maya (Partner): hi all — partner wants a joint POC next week. need: 1) 2-week pricing for private deployment 2) exact network checklist and SSO requirements 3) subprocessors list for their security team.
Jordan (Sales): noted. timeline? they want to start in 7 days. can we do a prorated reserved for 2 weeks?
Priya (Prod Eng): we can. SSO: SAML or OIDC. for SAML we need IdP metadata XML + ACS URL. network ports: 443 (API), 50051 (gRPC optional), kube ops 10250 for on-prem; CIDR for peering: 10.22.0.0/16.
Sam (Solutions): perf estimate: ~30 concurrent sessions, seq len ~512 -> recommend 3x A40 equiv for POC. batching 20-30ms to keep p95 < 300ms. I'll draft a prorated quote.
legal@redwood: will provide trimmed subprocessors list and sample MAA within 48h. audit requests require scoped process.
compliance-bot: compliance docs: https://redwood.example.com/compliance. retention default 30d, TLS1.2+, AES-256 at rest.
Maya (Partner): partner also needs cert rotation cadence and ability to shorten retention to contract terms.
Priya (Prod Eng): cert rotation: default 90d, support CMK via KMS for disk keys. retention can be shortened in contract.
Jordan (Sales): next steps — Sam to send preliminary quote today, Priya to post network checklist + SAML attribute list by tomorrow, legal to share subprocessors. Partner to supply IdP metadata + infra contact within 48h.
Maya (Partner): thanks — will route to infra and security and get metadata. :thumbsup:
